news.title: SEC proposes transfer agent rule, sets event to figure out round-the-clock U.S. trading
news.summary: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission issued an agenda for its 24-trading roundtable and proposed a new transfer-agent rule with blockchain implications.

news.title: Citi, Goldman, other global banks and asset managers team up on stablecoin venture
news.summary: The group will focus first on a U.S. dollar stablecoin for payments and digital asset settlement, with a euro token a priority for expansion.

news.title: Robinhood's new crypto network is printing cash, and it's sending Arbitrum's token soaring
news.summary: Revenue on Robinhood Chain hit a 24-hour record of $1.9 million, driving a 30% rally in ARB as traders chased downstream gains.
